description: This PHP source file defines the WebProcessor class within the Goteo project, specifically for handling and enriching log records with request, session, user, and contextual information, which can be used for logging or debugging purposes.

classes.name: WebProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for augmenting log records with request, session, user, and other contextual information for debugging and tracking user interactions within a web application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebProcessor with a Request object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Enables the object to be used as a callable to process a log record, delegating to processRecord.

methods.name: processRecord
methods.description: Enhances the log record with session identifiers, user info, request data, and other contextual info.

methods.name: processObject
methods.description: Processes an array of context objects, converting objects into associative arrays with defined properties for logging.
